name: cl_Na8Cl8
title: (NaCl)8 cluster
description: Gas-phase (NaCl)8. Small alkali-halide clusters adopt rocksalt-cuboid structures in ab initio and Tosi-Fumi studies (Aguado et al., PRB 56, 15353 (1997); Doye & Wales, PRB 59, 2292 (1999)), and the NEP89 putative GM is the 2x2x4 rocksalt cuboid (Na-Cl 2.56-2.65 A). The landscape is soft: fmax = 0.05 relaxations of the same GM differ by up to 0.016 eV (0.3 meV after tight relaxation), hence e_tol = 0.05 eV.
